实验：验证机械能守恒定律: Experiment: Verifying Conservation of Mechanical Energy
½v² = gh（纸带测速度）: ½v² = gh (speed from a paper tape)
重物下落时，减少的重力势能是不是正好变成了增加的动能？一条纸带能不能把这件事量出: As a weight falls, does the gravitational potential energy it loses turn exactly into kinetic energy? Can one paper tape measure that?
只有重力做功（纸带竖直、限位孔对齐），机械能才守恒: Mechanical energy is conserved only when gravity alone does work (tape vertical, guide holes aligned)
先接通电源、后释放重物，纸带记下 O、A、B、C 一串点: Power on first, then release the weight; the tape records a row of dots O, A, B, C
中间时刻的速度 = 这段的平均速度：v_B = (h_C − h_A)/(2T): Speed at the middle moment = average speed over the interval: v_B = (h_C − h_A)/(2T)
½v² 与 gh 直接比 —— 消掉质量，两条腿都从纸带量出来: Compare ½v² with gh directly: mass cancels, and both sides come from the tape
½v²–h 过原点、斜率 ≈ g；差值来自阻力：ΔEp 略大于 ΔEk: ½v²–h passes through the origin with slope ≈ g; the gap comes from resistance: ΔEp is slightly larger than ΔEk

穿过限位孔的纸带、纸带上的点、量距离的刻度尺: Tape through the guide holes, dots on the tape, ruler for measuring distances
立着的坐标纸板与 ½v²–h 图: Upright graph board with the ½v²–h graph
桌上这些器材各干什么？纸带上的点是谁打出来的？重物凭什么挂在纸带下面？: What is each piece of equipment on the bench for? What prints the dots on the tape? Why does the weight hang from the bottom of the tape?
拖视角绕实验台看一圈：顺「铁架台竖杆 → 计时器 → 纸带 → 夹子 → 重物」: Drag the view around the bench and follow "stand rod → timer → tape → clip → weight"
Default setup (0.200 kg, B at dot 10, power on, ideal mode): v = 1.9600 m/s, h_B = 196.00 mm, ΔEp = ΔEk = 0.3842 J; the timer is clamped at the top of the rod, the tape runs through the guide holes, and the weight hangs from a clip at the bottom (the layout of textbook Fig. 8.5-2).
教材 p.96：利用打点计时器记录重物自由下落的运动过程。三个量各有各的测法——: Textbook p.96: use a ticker timer to record the free fall of a weight. Each quantity has its own method: mass by balance (p.96), height by measuring each dot's distance from O with a ruler (p.98, Fig. 8.5-5), and speed from three neighboring dots (p.97, Fig. 8.5-3); and conservation of mechanical energy requires that only gravity does work (p.95).
器材认得出：铁架台竖杆上端夹打点计时器、纸带穿过限位孔、下端用夹子挂重物。: Recognize the equipment: the ticker timer is clamped at the top of the stand rod, the tape passes through the guide holes, and the weight hangs from a clip at the bottom.
三个量三条路：质量用天平、高度用刻度尺在纸带上量、速度由纸带算。: Three quantities, three methods: mass by balance, height by ruler on the tape, speed calculated from the tape.
参考案例 2（气垫导轨 + 光电门）也能验，但那是另一套器材，本课不做。: Reference case 2 (air track + photogates) can also verify it, but that's different equipment, not used here.
去掉这一步：学生不知道哪个数是「量出来的」、哪个是「算出来的」。: Skip this step and students can't tell which numbers are "measured" and which are "calculated".
器材辨认是必做实验的第一项能力（课标 p.16「会使用所提供的实验器材进行实验并: Identifying equipment is the first skill of a required experiment (curriculum standard p.16: "use the equipment provided to carry out experiments and obtain data").
m 由天平读 · h 由刻度尺量 · v 由纸带算: m from the balance · h from the ruler · v from the tape
这一步先做哪一件事？如果先松手、后接电源，纸带上会少掉什么？: What do you do first in this step? If you let go first and power on later, what's missing from the tape?
纸带已经挂好：把打点计时器电源拨到接通，先通电、再释放重物: The tape is already hung: switch the ticker timer power on, power first, then release the weight
电源关着时纸带一个点也没有，v、h、ΔEp、ΔEk 全显示「—」（不是 0）；拨: With the power off, the tape has no dots and v, h, ΔEp and ΔEk all show "—" (not 0); switched on, the tape gets 15 dots and v = 1.9600 m/s. In the wrong order (release first, power later), the first 49.0 mm of tape is blank (48.4 mm in real mode), 5 dots are missing, and every h measured from O is invalid.
教材 p.98 原句「实验中，先接通电源，再释放重物」；打点计时器用交流电源、5: Textbook p.98: "In the experiment, switch on the power first, then release the weight"; the ticker timer runs on 50 Hz AC and prints a dot every 0.02 s (Required Book 1, p.18), so neighboring dots are T = 0.02 s apart.
facts A2.9、A2.16、A4.4、A7.1；p.98、必修一 p.18: facts A2.9, A2.16, A4.4, A7.1; p.98, Required Book 1 p.18; B2.1 items 10, 11
顺序是「先接通电源、再释放重物」，打完立即断电。: The order is "power on, then release the weight", and switch off as soon as it's done.
50 Hz ⇒ 每隔 0.02 s 打一次点，相邻两点间隔 T = 0.02 s: 50 Hz ⇒ one dot every 0.02 s, so neighboring dots are T = 0.02 s apart.
顺序错的后果有数：开头 49.0 mm 白纸、少 5 个点，从 O 量起的 h: The wrong order has a measurable cost: 49.0 mm blank at the start, 5 dots missing, every h from O invalid.
去掉这一步：学生直接拿到一条「已经打好」的纸带，不知道它为什么可信。: Skip this step and students just get a tape that's "already printed", without knowing why it can be trusted.
必考：操作顺序与「为什么」（课标 p.16「能明确实验需要测量的物理量」）。: Exam must-know: the procedure order and why (curriculum standard p.16: "identify the physical quantities the experiment needs to measure").
T = 0.02 s（50 Hz）· 空白 = ½g(0.10 s)² = 49: T = 0.02 s (50 Hz) · blank = ½g(0.10 s)² = 49.0 mm
交流 8 V · 先通电后释放: AC 8 V · power on, then release
从哪儿开始量？O 点旁边那串挤在一起的点能直接用吗？取第几个点做 B 才量得准？: Where do you start measuring? Can you use the crowded dots next to O directly? Which dot should be B for an accurate measurement?
B 点先取第 4 点（点太密、读数相对误差大），把「B 点取第几个点」拨到第 1: B starts at dot 4 (dots too dense, large relative reading error); switch "B at dot" to dot 10 or later
四个测点（理想档、0.200 kg）：第 4 点 → h_B = 31.36 m: Four measuring points (ideal mode, 0.200 kg): dot 4 → h_B = 31.36 mm, v = 0.7840 m/s, single-reading relative error 0.32 % (tag "dots too dense"); dot 7 → 96.04 mm, 1.3720 m/s, 0.10 %; dot 10 → 196.00 mm, 1.9600 m/s, 0.05 %; dot 13 → 331.24 mm, 2.5480 m/s, 0.03 %.
教材 p.98 图8.5-5 的 O 点旁边就是一串密集点，直接从 O 量起读数: In textbook Fig. 8.5-5 (p.98) the dots next to O are crowded, so measuring directly from O is inaccurate. The answer to the textbook's question on p.96, "which two positions are best as the start and end of the process", is two positions far apart with clear dots: the larger h is, the smaller the relative error of 0.1 mm.
facts A2.17、A4.5、A7.2；图8.5-5（p.98）；B1.5、: facts A2.17, A4.5, A7.2; Fig. 8.5-5 (p.98); B1.5, standard values table B
图8.5-5 的 O 点旁是一串密集点，直接从 O 量起相对误差大。: Next to O in Fig. 8.5-5 is a cluster of dense dots; measuring from O there gives a large relative error.
取距离远、点迹清晰的三个连续点，h 越大 0.1 mm 的相对误差越小。: Take three consecutive dots that are far along and clear: the larger h is, the smaller the relative error of 0.1 mm.
B 点一取，A、B、C 三个点就同时定了（A、C 是它的左右邻点）。: Choosing B fixes A, B and C together (A and C are its left and right neighbors).
去掉这一步：学生会从最密的地方开始量，误差比阻力误差还大。: Skip this step and students start measuring where the dots are densest, with errors larger than the resistance error.
必考：选测量位置的理由（课标 p.16「能明确科学探究实验所要解决的问题」）。: Exam must-know: the reason for choosing measuring positions (curriculum standard p.16: "identify the problem a scientific investigation sets out to solve").
v_B 是用哪两个点算的？为什么不是 (h_C − h_B)/T？: Which two dots is v_B calculated from? Why not (h_C − h_B)/T?
盯住纸带上的 A、B、C 三点与刻度尺量出的 h_A、h_C: Watch dots A, B and C on the tape and the h_A and h_C measured by the ruler
教材 p.97 图8.5-3 的原句「B 点的瞬时速度等于 A、C 点之间的平均: Textbook Fig. 8.5-3 (p.97): "the instantaneous speed at B equals the average speed between A and C". The speed at the middle moment equals the average speed over that interval, so divide the displacement from A to C by 2T. The answer to exercise 1 on p.98 is ΔEp = mgh_B, ΔEk = ½mv_B² (no need to find the acceleration first, and (h_C − h_B)/T can't be used as the speed at B).
v_B 用 A、C 两点的位移除以 2T，不是 (h_C − h_B)/T。: v_B is the A-to-C displacement divided by 2T, not (h_C − h_B)/T.
ΔEp 用 h_B（到 O 的距离），ΔEk 用 v_B²，两条腿各用各的测量值: ΔEp uses h_B (distance to O) and ΔEk uses v_B²: each side uses its own measurement.
½v² 与 gh 相等这件事不需要知道质量，第 6 步还要用它。: ½v² equalling gh doesn't require knowing the mass; step 6 uses this again.
去掉这一步：v 就成了纸上蹦出来的一个数，学生没有「量出来」的办法。: Skip this step and v becomes a number that pops out of the paper, with no way for students to "measure" it.
必考：由纸带求瞬时速度（课标 p.16「能用物理图像描述实验数据」）。: Exam must-know: finding instantaneous speed from a tape (curriculum standard p.16: "describe experimental data with physical graphs").
四个测点画在 ½v²–h 图上是什么形状？斜率是多少？跟 g 比呢？: What shape do four measuring points make on a ½v²–h graph? What's the slope, and how does it compare with g?
B 点从第 4 点换到第 13 点，每个测点按「记录一组」存一行，记满 4 行: Move B from dot 4 to dot 13, pressing "Record" at each to save a row, until you have 4 rows
把 ½v² 对 h 作图、过原点，就是教材 p.96「数据分析」那两条守恒式消去: Plotting ½v² against h through the origin follows directly from cancelling mass in the two conservation expressions in the textbook's "Data Analysis" on p.96 (½v² = gh); the slope is the g measured by this tape, and comparing it with 9.8 m/s² is the "verification". Textbook p.96: design a table to record the data according to the chosen method.
facts A2.2, A2.3, A2.7, A2.14; p.91, p.96; B2.1 item 9, standard values table E
四个点要落在过原点的直线上，斜率就是 g —— 不是「看着像直线」。: The four points should lie on a line through the origin with slope g, not just "look straight".
点是「记录一组」存下来的，不是纸上自己画的：记 4 组就够。: Points are stored with "Record", not drawn by hand: 4 sets are enough.
表里 ½v² 那一列与 gh 那一列每行都应相等（差就是阻力与读数误差）。: In the table, the ½v² column and the gh column should match row by row (the difference is resistance and reading error).
去掉这一步：½v² = gh 就成了背下来的结论，学生没有证据。: Skip this step and ½v² = gh becomes a memorized conclusion with no evidence.
必考：用图像处理数据、由斜率读出物理量（课标 p.16「能通过对数据的分析发现其: Exam must-know: processing data with graphs and reading a physical quantity from the slope (curriculum standard p.16: "find patterns by analyzing data and draw conclusions").
把重物从 0.050 kg 换到 0.500 kg，纸带上的 h、v 会变吗？天: Change the weight from 0.050 kg to 0.500 kg. Do h and v on the tape change? Is the balance really necessary?
重物先取最轻的 0.050 kg，把「重物质量」拨到 0.500 kg，看纸带上: Start with the lightest weight, 0.050 kg, then switch "Weight mass" to 0.500 kg and see whether h, v and the slope change
理想档换质量，纸带上的 h 与 v 一位都不变（v 恒为 1.9600 m/s、: In ideal mode, changing the mass doesn't change a single digit of h or v (v stays 1.9600 m/s, h_B 196.00 mm, slope 9.80); only ΔEp and ΔEk change (0.0960 ↔ 0.9604 J, in proportion to mass). Only real mode depends on mass: δ goes from −5.10 % (0.050 kg) to −2.55 % (0.100 kg), −1.28 % (0.200 kg) and −0.51 % (0.500 kg).
教材 p.96 旁注问「实验时，其实可以不测量物体的质量。想一想，这是为什么？」: A margin note on textbook p.96 asks: "In fact the mass need not be measured. Why?" Because both sides of ½mv² = mgh contain m, it cancels, and comparing ½v² with gh is enough, so the balance isn't essential. In real mode, the heavier the weight, the smaller the share of resistance (δ = −f/(mg)); this is the first answer to question 1 on p.96, "how to reduce the effect of resistance".
facts A2.7、A2.19、A2.13、A4.3、A7.5；p.96 旁注: facts A2.7, A2.19, A2.13, A4.3, A7.5; p.96 margin note and question 1; B3 item 1; standard values tables A4, A5, C
理想档换质量什么都不变：h、v、斜率一位不变，这是「可以不测质量」的直接证据。: In ideal mode changing mass changes nothing: h, v and slope don't move a digit, direct evidence that "mass need not be measured".
真实档才随质量变：δ = −f/(mg)，重物越重越接近 g。: Only real mode varies with mass: δ = −f/(mg), so a heavier weight gets closer to g.
这一步只准拨「重物质量」这一档，测点一个都不许动（控制变量）。: In this step change only "Weight mass"; don't move any measuring point (controlled variables).
去掉这一步：学生会把「天平必须用」当成规矩，也说不出阻力占比为什么跟质量有关。: Skip this step and students treat "you must use a balance" as a rule and can't say why resistance's share depends on mass.
必考：控制变量 + 教材旁注「其实可以不测量物体的质量」（A7.5、A2.19）: Exam must-know: controlled variables + the textbook margin note "in fact the mass need not be measured" (A7.5, A2.19).
「势能减少量略大于动能增加量」是算错了还是装置的问题？纸带没摆正会怎样？: Is "the potential energy lost is slightly more than the kinetic energy gained" a calculation mistake or a problem with the apparatus? What if the tape isn't straight?
把三档开关从「理想」拨到「真实·纸带竖直」看一遍，再拨到「真实·纸带歪斜」看第二: Switch the three-way switch from "Ideal" to "Real · tape vertical" and look, then to "Real · tape slanted" and look again
① 理想：δ = 0、k = 9.80。② 真实·纸带竖直：δ = −1.28: ① Ideal: δ = 0, k = 9.80. ② Real · tape vertical: δ = −1.28 %, k = 9.68, ΔEp − ΔEk = 0.0048 J, resistance f = 0.025 N. ③ Real · tape slanted: δ = −3.21 %, k = 9.49, f = 0.0625 N. All three are straight lines through the origin, just with smaller slopes: not shifted, not curved.
教材 p.98 练习 1(3) 原话「很多实验结果显示，重力势能的减少量略大于动: The answer to exercise 1(3) on textbook p.98, "Many results show the loss of gravitational potential energy is slightly larger than the gain in kinetic energy. Why do you think that is?": as the weight falls it meets air resistance and friction between the tape and the guide holes, and resistance does negative work ⇒ ΔEk = ΔEp − f·h, δ = −f/(mg) < 0 (always negative). To reduce it: use a heavier weight (step 6), keep the three-way switch on "Real · tape vertical", and align the guide holes.
facts A2.13、A2.18、A2.20、A4.2、A7.4；p.96 问: facts A2.13, A2.18, A2.20, A4.2, A7.4; p.96 question 1, p.98 exercise 1(3); B3 items 1, 2; standard values tables A, C, D, E
两种毛病都不改变过原点，只改变斜率（与「木板没垫好」那种平移型误差不同）。: Neither fault moves the line off the origin; both only change the slope (unlike the shift-type error from a board that isn't raised properly).
方向恒定：ΔEp > ΔEk、k < g、δ < 0，不是「有时大有时小」。: The direction is fixed: ΔEp > ΔEk, k < g, δ < 0, not "sometimes higher, sometimes lower".
三档开关的最后一档（纸带歪斜）把摩擦放大到 2.5 倍，δ 从 −1.28 %: The last setting of the switch (tape slanted) multiplies friction by 2.5, and δ drops from −1.28 % to −3.21 %.
实验素养：说出误差来源与方向（课标 p.16「知道实验存在误差」；A7.4）。: Lab skills: state error sources and their direction (curriculum standard p.16: "know that experiments have errors"; A7.4).
给你一条打好的纸带，不查表、不算加速度，能不能把当地的 g 测出来？: Given a printed tape, can you measure local g without looking it up or calculating acceleration?
记满 3 组以上、测点不同、同一个重物，让 ½v²–h 的过原点斜率与 9.8: Record at least 3 sets at different dots with the same weight, so the through-origin slope of ½v²–h is within 2 % of 9.8 m/s²
达标条件：① 记满 3 组以上；② 每组取不同的测点；③ 三次记录同一个重物；④: Pass conditions: ① at least 3 sets recorded; ② each set uses a different dot; ③ all records use the same weight; ④ the through-origin slope is within 2 % of 9.8 m/s². One valid solution: 0.200 kg, ideal mode, recording dots 4/7/10/13 → k = 9.80, 0.00 % off (real · vertical · 0.200 kg also passes: k = 9.68, −1.18 %). Counterexamples: 0.050 kg in real mode k = 9.31, −5.00 %; tape slanted k = 9.49, −3.17 %.
没有新结论：把前七步连起来用一遍——选点、量 h、算 v、作图，斜率就是 g。这: No new conclusion: use the first seven steps together (choose dots, measure h, find v, plot) and the slope is g. This is exactly the quantitative test of the law of conservation of mechanical energy on textbook p.92.
facts A2.7、A2.14、A7.4、A7.5；p.92、p.96；B3: facts A2.7, A2.14, A7.4, A7.5; p.92, p.96; B3 item 4, standard values tables E, F
先按 k ≈ 9.8 估一下斜率，再看记的组数够不够（≥ 3 组、测点不同）。: Estimate the slope as k ≈ 9.8 first, then check you have enough sets (≥ 3, at different dots).
三组必须是同一个重物，中途换质量会把斜率搞乱（判据会判不通过）。: All three sets must use the same weight; changing mass midway messes up the slope (and fails the check).
真实档也能过，但要选较重的重物 + 纸带竖直。: Real mode can pass too, but choose a heavier weight + vertical tape.
没有新结论：把前七步连起来用一遍就是考核。: No new conclusion: the assessment chains the first seven steps together.
综合：选点 + 量 h + 算 v + 过原点斜率 = g。: Synthesis: choose dots + measure h + find v + through-origin slope = g.

电源接通：计时器每 0.02 s 打一个点，纸带开始记录。: Power on: the timer prints a dot every 0.02 s and the tape starts recording.
电源断开：纸带上没有点，测量读数一律显示「—」。: Power off: no dots on the tape, and all readings show "—".
理想器材：没有阻力，ΔEp 与 ΔEk 严格相等（教材的理想情况）。: Ideal equipment: no resistance, so ΔEp and ΔEk are exactly equal (the textbook's ideal case).
真实器材、纸带竖直穿过限位孔：空气阻力与纸带摩擦共 0.025 N，ΔEp 比: Real equipment, tape vertical through the guide holes: air resistance and tape friction total 0.025 N, so ΔEp is a little more than ΔEk.
纸带歪斜：摩擦放大到 2.5 倍（0.0625 N），偏差从 −1.28 % 变: Tape slanted: friction is multiplied by 2.5 (0.0625 N), and the deviation grows from −1.28 % to −3.21 %.
┈ k = g 参照 · ○ 记录点 · — 过原点拟合: ┈ k = g reference · ○ recorded points · — through-origin fit
数据记录（同一个重物的几组测点）: Data log (several points with the same weight)
用一条纸带测出当地的 g: Measure local g with one tape
换测点记满 3 组以上（同一个重物）→ 看 ½v²–h 的过原点斜率，与 9.8: Record at least 3 sets at different dots (same weight) → check the through-origin slope of ½v²–h is within 2 % of 9.8 m/s²
打纸带时的正确顺序是: The correct order when recording a tape is
先释放重物，再接通电源: Release the weight first, then switch on the power
先接通电源，再释放重物: Switch on the power first, then release the weight
两者同时，没有差别: Both at once; it makes no difference
先断电再释放重物: Switch off the power, then release the weight
教材 p.98 原句「实验中，先接通电源，再释放重物」：先松手会白掉开头一段。: Textbook p.98: "In the experiment, switch on the power first, then release the weight"; letting go first wastes the start of the tape.
纸带上相邻三点 A、B、C，打点周期 T，B 点的瞬时速度是: For three neighboring dots A, B, C on the tape with dot period T, the instantaneous speed at B is
教材 p.97 图8.5-3：中间时刻的速度等于这段时间内的平均速度，所以用 A: Textbook Fig. 8.5-3 (p.97): the speed at the middle moment equals the average speed over the interval, so divide the A-to-C displacement by 2T.
以 h 为横轴、½v² 为纵轴作图，若机械能守恒，图线应当是: Plotting ½v² against h, if mechanical energy is conserved, the graph should be
一条过原点的直线，斜率 ≈ g: A straight line through the origin with slope ≈ g
一条不过原点的直线: A straight line not through the origin
½v² = gh（m 消去）：过原点、斜率就是 g；差值（斜率偏小）来自阻力。: ½v² = gh (m cancels): through the origin with slope g; the gap (slope too small) comes from resistance.
真实实验里，重力势能的减少量略大于动能的增加量，主要原因是: In a real experiment the loss of gravitational potential energy is slightly more than the gain in kinetic energy, mainly because
重物的质量测错了: The weight's mass was measured wrong
打点周期取错了: The dot period was taken wrong
空气阻力与纸带和限位孔的摩擦做负功: Air resistance and friction between the tape and guide holes do negative work
刻度尺读数偏小: The ruler readings are too small
教材 p.98 练习 1(3) 就是问这件事：阻力做负功 ⇒ ΔEk = ΔEp: This is exactly what exercise 1(3) on textbook p.98 asks: resistance does negative work ⇒ ΔEk = ΔEp − f·h, always in the negative direction.
用一条打点纸带量出重物下落时的速度与高度，验证 ½v² = gh，并说出阻力让结: Use one dotted tape to measure a falling weight's speed and height, verify ½v² = gh, and say which way resistance pushes the result.
